# An escaping region use in a Go package falls back to the heap with a
# perf::arena_fallback diagnostic, never a correctness::region_escape error.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena

cd m
logos lint .
stderr 'main\.go:23:22: warning: \[perf::arena_fallback\]'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos lint --json-diagnostics .
stderr '"rule_id":"perf::arena_fallback"'
stderr '"severity":"warn"'
logos build .
stderr 'main\.go:23:22: warning: \[perf::arena_fallback\]'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos vet .
go vet .
logos run .
stdout '^42$'
stdout '^heap true$'
go run .
stdout '^42$'
stdout '^heap true$'

# A returned region object falls back with the call position.
cd ../ret
logos lint .
stderr 'main\.go:17:21: warning: \[perf::arena_fallback\]'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos build .
stderr 'main\.go:17:21: warning: \[perf::arena_fallback\]'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos run .
stdout '^7$'
stdout '^heap true$'
go run .
stdout '^7$'
stdout '^heap true$'

# A region object sent on a channel falls back with the call position.
# Lint stays out: repeated channel operations trip the unrelated
# unbounded-channel rule, so the build and the runs carry this case.
cd ../chan
logos build .
stderr 'main\.go:22:22: warning: \[perf::arena_fallback\]'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos run .
stdout '^9$'
stdout '^heap true$'
go run .
stdout '^9$'
stdout '^heap true$'

# A local region object stays silent and stays out of the heap:
# lint reports nothing and both drivers measure no heap growth.
cd ../non
logos lint .
! stderr 'arena_fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos run .
stdout '^42$'
stdout '^heap false$'
go run .
stdout '^42$'
stdout '^heap false$'
# Placement stays off without the experiment. The off directory holds
# a non-escaping use: with the experiment plain go places it in the
# region, without it both commands keep it on the heap with no
# placement diagnostic and identical output.
cd ../off
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
go build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:.*placed in region'
! stderr 'region_escape'
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos build -gcflags=-m .
! stderr 'placed in region'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos run .
stdout '^42$'
go build -gcflags=-m .
! stderr 'placed in region'
! stderr 'region_escape'
go run .
stdout '^42$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagofallback

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"

	"logos/arena"
)

var saved *int

func totalAlloc() uint64 {
	var m runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	return m.TotalAlloc
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	const K = 10000
	a0 := totalAlloc()
	for range K {
		q := arena.New[int](r)
		*q = 42
		saved = q
	}
	a1 := totalAlloc()
	fmt.Println(*saved)
	fmt.Println("heap", a1-a0 > 65536)
	_ = r
}

-- ret/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagofallbackret

go 1.27

-- ret/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"

	"logos/arena"
)

func totalAlloc() uint64 {
	var m runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	return m.TotalAlloc
}

func makePtr(r arena.Region) *int {
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 7
	return p
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	q := makePtr(r)
	n := *q
	const K = 10000
	a0 := totalAlloc()
	for range K {
		s := makePtr(r)
		n = *s
	}
	a1 := totalAlloc()
	fmt.Println(n)
	fmt.Println("heap", a1-a0 > 65536)
	_ = r
}

-- chan/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagofallbackchan

go 1.27

-- chan/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"

	"logos/arena"
)

func totalAlloc() uint64 {
	var m runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	return m.TotalAlloc
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	const K = 10000
	ch := make(chan *int, K)
	a0 := totalAlloc()
	for range K {
		q := arena.New[int](r)
		*q = 9
		ch <- q
	}
	a1 := totalAlloc()
	n := 0
	for range K {
		n = *<-ch
	}
	fmt.Println(n)
	fmt.Println("heap", a1-a0 > 65536)
	_ = r
}
-- non/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagofallbacknon

go 1.27

-- non/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"

	"logos/arena"
)

func totalAlloc() uint64 {
	var m runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	return m.TotalAlloc
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 41
	n := *p + 1
	const K = 10000
	a0 := totalAlloc()
	for range K {
		q := arena.New[int](r)
		*q = 41
		n = *q + 1
	}
	a1 := totalAlloc()
	fmt.Println(n)
	fmt.Println("heap", a1-a0 > 65536)
	_ = r
}

-- off/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagooff

go 1.27

-- off/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false

-- off/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 41
	fmt.Println(*p + 1)
	_ = r
}
